note: The select/pick-out sense that «Ско́ро жюри́ отберёт фина́листов» and four siblings need is already an accepted answer via the existing alt 'to select', so nothing is missing.
The spreading/covering sense in «Ого́нь охва́тит весь дом» and «рефо́рма охва́тит всю страну́» is already reached by the existing alt 'to encompass'.

alt: to worry (переживать за + acc — to be anxious on someone else's behalf)
note: «Я пережива́ю за тебя́» and three more sentences need the worry-about-someone sense, which appears only inside the standard's parenthetical and so is not an accepted answer.

alt: to switch (to move over to another job, topic or side)
note: «Он перешёл на другу́ю рабо́ту» and «Мы перейдём к сле́дующей те́ме» need the switch/transfer sense, which no accepted gloss carries.

alt: to postpone (to move an event to a later date)
to endure (to come through an illness)
note: «Они́ перенесли́ встре́чу на пя́тницу» needs 'postpone' and «Он перенёс тяжёлую боле́знь» needs 'endure'; neither sense is an accepted answer today.

alt: to switch (to move over to another job, topic or side)
note: «Он переходи́л на но́вую рабо́ту» and «Мы перехо́дим к гла́вному вопро́су» need the switch/transfer sense that the graded gloss 'to cross' lacks, exactly as for its perfective partner.

Only «Я пожале́ю де́нег на тако́е де́ло» would need a 'begrudge' sense, and the reviewer flagged that very sentence as an odd affirmative that a human may reword, so widening on it would loosen grading for one doubtful example.
«Вдали́ показа́лся ма́ленький дом» is the come-into-view sense, which the existing alt 'to appear' already accepts.
«Ско́ро ли́стья покрасне́ют о́сенью» needs the plain go-red sense, and the existing alt 'to redden' already covers it.
Every sentence here is the come-to-love sense; the flag on «Я полюби́ла бы э́тот край» is about the separate headword «край» being glossed 'edge', not about this entry.

key: помолчать=to be silent for a while
note: The flag confirms the gloss is right — «Он помолча́л, а пото́м заговори́л» is the delimitative 'be silent for a while', and 'fall silent' would be замолча́ть.
«Мне попа́лся о́чень лёгкий биле́т» is the turn-up/come-across sense, already accepted via the alt 'to come across'; the flag is about «биле́т» being glossed 'ticket', a different headword.
All six sentences are the same try/attempt sense the gloss already states; the flag is about a tap hint's wording in «Ты попыта́ешься откры́ть дверь?», not a missing sense.
«Ба́бушка посади́ла ро́зы в саду́» needs the planting sense, which the existing alt 'to plant' already accepts.
«Мно́гие поступа́ют в университе́т по́сле шко́лы» needs the enrol sense, and the existing alt 'to enrol' already accepts it.
«Она́ поступи́ла в университе́т в э́том году́» is covered by the existing alt 'to enrol'.

alt: to expect (to anticipate an outcome, or to intend to do something)
note: «Никто́ не предполага́л тако́го конца́» and «Мы предполага́ем нача́ть рабо́ту в ма́е» need the expect/intend sense, which no accepted gloss carries.

alt: to imagine (представить себе — to picture something in your mind)
note: «Предста́вьте себе́ ти́хий о́стров» needs the imagine sense, which lives only in the standard's parenthetical; the introduce sense in «Я предста́влю вам своего́ дру́га» is still within 'to present'.

alt: to seem (of a task or a situation — to strike one as being a certain way)
note: «Зада́ча представля́лась о́чень тру́дной» needs the seem sense, which appears only inside the parenthetical and so is not an accepted answer.

alt: to close (to push a door to, leaving it not quite shut)
note: «Я сейча́с прикро́ю дверь от сквозняка́» needs the push-a-door-to sense; 'to cover' does not reach it, and the note keeps it apart from закры́ть 'to close (to shut)'.

alt: to take (принимать лекарство — to take medicine)
to receive (to have guests or patients in)
note: «Я принима́ла бы лека́рство ре́же» needs 'to take' and «В пя́тницу мы бу́дем принима́ть госте́й» / «Врач принима́ет пацие́нтов у́тром» need 'to receive'; neither is an accepted answer today.

alt: to conduct (to carry out an experiment or a lesson)
note: «Учёный проведёт ва́жный о́пыт» needs the conduct/carry-out sense, which sits only in the parenthetical of the standard gloss.

alt: to spend (time — to pass hours or days doing something)
note: «Они́ прово́дят мно́го вре́мени вме́сте» needs the spend-time sense, and the note keeps it apart from тра́тить 'to spend (to use up money)'.

alt: to talk for a while (to spend a stretch of time talking — проговори́ть всю ночь)
note: «Она́ проговори́ла всю ночь с подру́гой» is the delimitative talk-for-a-stretch sense that 'to utter' cannot reach; the wordy short gloss keeps it from loosely accepting plain 'to talk'.
«Я пройду́ медосмо́тр за́втра» is the undergo sense, which the existing alt 'to go through' already accepts.

alt: to turn around (to turn a vehicle to face the other way)
note: «Я разверну́ маши́ну» and «Ты развернёшь маши́ну?» need the turn-a-vehicle-around sense, which no accepted gloss carries; «Она́ разверну́ла пода́рок» (unwrap) stays within 'to unfold'.

alt: to dilute (to thin paint or powder with water)
to light (развести костёр — to get a campfire going)
note: «Он развёл кра́ску водо́й» needs 'to dilute' and «Я разведу́ костёр в лесу́» needs 'to light'; the graded gloss 'to breed' covers neither.

alt: to resolve (to settle a dispute or a problem)
note: «Они́ разреши́ли э́тот спор» and «Вы разреши́те э́тот спор?» need the settle-a-dispute sense, absent from every accepted gloss.

alt: to tear (of thread or cloth — to snap under strain)
note: «Ни́тки легко́ рву́тся» needs the intransitive tear/snap sense, which 'to rush' does not reach.

alt: to roll up (to roll a carpet or a map into a tube)
note: «Я сверну́ ковёр» and «Ты свернёшь ковёр?» need the roll-up sense, which appears only in the standard's parenthetical.

alt: to pass (an exam — to sit it successfully)
to rent out (to let a flat to a tenant)
note: Four sentences including «Я сдам экза́мен в ию́не» need the pass-an-exam sense and «Они́ сдаду́т кварти́ру в аре́нду» needs the let-out sense; neither is accepted today.
«Вам сле́дует отдохну́ть» and «Не сле́дует так говори́ть с ма́терью» are already served by the existing alt 'one should'.

alt: to add up (to total figures)
to pack (to stack things into a case or a cupboard)
note: «Сло́жите э́ти чи́сла вме́сте» needs the arithmetic sense and «Я сложу́ все ве́щи в чемода́н за́втра» the stack-away sense; 'to fold' reaches neither, though the pack alt is the weaker of the two.

alt: to rent (to rent a place as the tenant)
to film (to shoot a film or a scene)
note: «Они́ снима́ли кварти́ру в це́нтре» needs 'to rent' and «Он снима́ет фильм о приро́де» needs 'to film'; both sit only in the parenthetical or nowhere at all.

alt: to rent (to rent a place as the tenant)
to film (to shoot a film or a scene)
to withdraw (to take money out of an account)
note: «Они́ сня́ли дом на ле́то» needs 'to rent', «Фильм снят в Москве́» needs 'to film', and «Я сниму́ де́ньги со счёта за́втра» needs 'to withdraw' — none of them accepted by 'to take off'.

alt: to think clearly (to have your wits about you)
note: «Я пло́хо сообража́ю у́тром» and «Он бы́стро сообража́ет» are about mental sharpness, not comprehension, so 'to understand' does not reach them.
Every sentence is the plain hide/conceal sense; the flag is about «шкаф» being rendered 'wardrobe' rather than its own gloss 'cupboard', not about this headword.
«Не сунь па́льцы в розе́тку» is still the shove/stick-in sense the gloss states; the flag is about one sentence's tap hint saying 'stuck', not a missing sense.
All seven sentences are the same hurry sense; the flag concerns a sentence rendering торопи́ться as 'rush' rather than matching its gloss.

alt: to hang around (colloquial — to idle in a place for hours)
note: «Мы це́лый день торча́ли до́ма» and «Я не торча́ла бы тут весь день» need the colloquial idle-somewhere sense, which the graded gloss 'to stick out' cannot reach.
